title: Building Bridge
statementMd:
Two villages are separated by a river that flows from the north to the south. The villagers want to build a bridge across the river to make it easier to move across the villages.

The river banks can be assumed to be vertical straight lines $*x* = *a*$ and $*x* = *b*$ ($0 < *a* < *b*$).

The west village lies in a steppe at point $*O* = (0, 0)$. There are $*n*$ pathways leading from the village to the river, they end at points $*A*_{*i*} = (*a*, *y*_{*i*})$. The villagers there are plain and simple, so their pathways are straight segments as well.

The east village has reserved and cunning people. Their village is in the forest on the east bank of the river, but its exact position is not clear. There are $*m*$ twisted paths leading from this village to the river and ending at points $*B*_{*i*} = (*b*, *y*'_{*i*})$. The lengths of all these paths are known, the length of the path that leads from the eastern village to point $*B*_{*i*}$, equals $*l*_{*i*}$.

The villagers want to choose exactly one point on the left bank of river $*A*_{*i*}$, exactly one point on the right bank $*B*_{*j*}$ and connect them by a straight-line bridge so as to make the total distance between the villages (the sum of $|*OA*_{*i*}| + |*A*_{*i*}*B*_{*j*}| + *l*_{*j*}$, where $|*XY*|$ is the Euclidean distance between points $*X*$ and $*Y*$) were minimum. The Euclidean distance between points $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ and $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ equals ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a524adf9e9acb2416e49b80067d4fda89423836e.png).

Help them and find the required pair of points.

## Input

The first line contains integers $*n*$, $*m*$, $*a*$, $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$, $0 < *a* < *b* < 10^{6}$).

The second line contains $*n*$ integers in the ascending order: the $*i*$-th integer determines the coordinate of point $*A*_{*i*}$ and equals $*y*_{*i*}$ ($|*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{6}$).

The third line contains $*m*$ integers in the ascending order: the $*i*$-th integer determines the coordinate of point $*B*_{*i*}$ and equals $*y*'_{*i*}$ ($|*y*'_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{6}$).

The fourth line contains $*m*$ more integers: the $*i*$-th of them determines the length of the path that connects the eastern village and point $*B*_{*i*}$, and equals $*l*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$).

It is guaranteed, that there is such a point $*C*$ with abscissa at least $*b*$, that $|*B*_{*i*}*C*| ≤ *l*_{*i*}$ for all $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*)$. It is guaranteed that no two points $*A*_{*i*}$ coincide. It is guaranteed that no two points $*B*_{*i*}$ coincide.

## Output

Print two integers — the numbers of points on the left (west) and right (east) banks, respectively, between which you need to build a bridge. You can assume that the points on the west bank are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$, in the order in which they are given in the input. Similarly, the points on the east bank are numbered from $1$ to $*m*$ in the order in which they are given in the input.

If there are multiple solutions, print any of them. The solution will be accepted if the final length of the path will differ from the answer of the jury by no more than $10^{ - 6}$ in absolute or relative value.
statementZhMd:
两座村庄被一条自北向南流淌的河流隔开。为了方便往来，村民们希望在河上建造一座桥。

可以认为河岸是两条竖直直线 $*x* = *a*$ 和 $*x* = *b*$（$0 < *a* < *b*$）。

西边的村庄位于草原上，坐标为 $*O* = (0, 0)$。有 $*n*$ 条道路从村庄通向河边，分别终止于点 $*A*_{*i*} = (*a*, *y*_{*i*})$。那里的村民朴实简单，因此他们修建的道路也都是线段。

东边的村庄里住着谨慎而狡猾的人。村庄位于河流东岸的森林中，但其确切位置并不明确。有 $*m*$ 条蜿蜒的道路从村庄通向河边，分别终止于点 $*B*_{*i*} = (*b*, *y*'_{*i*})$。所有这些道路的长度都是已知的，从东边村庄通往点 $*B*_{*i*}$ 的道路长度为 $*l*_{*i*}$。

村民们希望选择左岸的恰好一个点 $*A*_{*i*}$、右岸的恰好一个点 $*B*_{*j*}$，并用一座直线桥将它们连接起来，使村庄之间的总距离最短（总距离为 $|*OA*_{*i*}| + |*A*_{*i*}*B*_{*j*}| + *l*_{*j*}$，其中 $|*XY*|$ 表示点 $*X*$ 与点 $*Y*$ 之间的欧几里得距离）。点 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ 和 $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ 之间的欧几里得距离等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a524adf9e9acb2416e49b80067d4fda89423836e.png)。

请帮助他们找出所需的一对点。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*n*$、$*m*$、$*a*$、$*b*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{5}$，$0 < *a* < *b* < 10^{6}$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个按升序排列的整数：第 $*i*$ 个整数确定点 $*A*_{*i*}$ 的坐标，并等于 $*y*_{*i*}$（$|*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{6}$）。

第三行包含 $*m*$ 个按升序排列的整数：第 $*i*$ 个整数确定点 $*B*_{*i*}$ 的坐标，并等于 $*y*'_{*i*}$（$|*y*'_{*i*}| ≤ 10^{6}$）。

第四行包含另外 $*m*$ 个整数：其中第 $*i*$ 个整数确定连接东边村庄与点 $*B*_{*i*}$ 的道路长度，并等于 $*l*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6}$）。

保证存在一个横坐标至少为 $*b*$ 的点 $*C*$，使得对于所有 $*i*$（$1 ≤ *i* ≤ *m*$），均有 $|*B*_{*i*}*C*| ≤ *l*_{*i*}$。
保证任意两个点 $*A*_{*i*}$ 不重合。
保证任意两个点 $*B*_{*i*}$ 不重合。

## 输出格式

输出两个整数，分别表示需要建造桥梁的左（西）岸点和右（东）岸点的编号。可以认为西岸的点按照输入中的顺序编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。同样，东岸的点按照输入中的顺序编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。

如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。如果最终路径长度与评测答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则答案将被接受。
